Suggest either a perceptually-ordered default for the continuous-hue path (e.g. viridis) or a docstring warning under hue=/colorbar= recommending a sequential palette for continuous data.

findings.title: palette documented as 'str' only, but list-of-RGB-tuples is accepted and functional
findings.description: plot() docs: "palette : str -- A matplotlib or seaborn color palette". Passing palette=[(1,0,0),(0,0,1)] works (verified -- datasets colored red/blue), and the package's own colors.mat2colors documents its palette parameter as "str or list -- Seaborn palette name (or list of RGB tuples)". plot()'s type line under-documents a supported, useful form.
findings.repro: env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg'); import hypertools as hyp; hyp.plot([np.random.randn(30,3), np.random.randn(30,3)], palette=[(1,0,0),(0,0,1)], show=False); print('ok')"
findings.actual: ok  -- list palette accepted; plot() docstring type says str only.
